hooks.command: fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *pnpm-lock.yaml|*.env|*.env.*) echo 'BLOCKED: do not edit lock files or .env files directly' >&2; exit 2;; esac

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // .tool_input.cmd // empty'); branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); ALLOW='^(\.(pi|codex|agents|omp|scratch)/|docs/|(apps/desktop|server)/AGENTS\.md$|[^/]+\.md$|\.gitignore$)'; NOTE='（仅 agent 配置与文档改动可直提直推）'; split_paths() { awk '{n=split($0,a,/ -> /);for(i=1;i<=n;i++)print a[i]}'; }; if [ "$branch" = "main" ] && echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+commit' && git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^??' | cut -c4- | split_paths | grep -qvE "$ALLOW"; then echo "BLOCKED: 在任务分支完成修改并开 PR,不要直接在 main 上提交$NOTE" >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push([^;&|]*)([[:space:]]main([[:space:]]|$)|:refs/heads/main|:main([[:space:]]|$))'; then base=$(git rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null) || { echo "BLOCKED: main 通过 PR squash merge 更新,不要直接 push main$NOTE" >&2; exit 2; }; files=$(git diff --no-renames --name-only "$base"..HEAD 2>/dev/null) || { echo "BLOCKED: main 通过 PR squash merge 更新,不要直接 push main$NOTE" >&2; exit 2; }; if [ -n "$files" ] && echo "$files" | grep -qvE "$ALLOW"; then echo "BLOCKED: main 通过 PR squash merge 更新,不要直接 push main$NOTE" >&2; exit 2; fi; fi
fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.yaml) npx prettier --write "$fp" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *.go) $(go env GOPATH)/bin/goimports -w "$fp" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
